subject: Fleet reservation checkpoint: AxisAI late-stage capacity soft hold
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, platform-ops@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fleet reservation checkpoint: AxisAI late-stage capacity soft hold

Ben / Ops team —

AxisAI (AX-4457) is in late-stage procurement; Sarah confirmed a yes-in-principle for Dedicated capacity pending a PO by the end of the month. They expect to start a 60-day pilot then convert to a committed pool. Key ask: can we do a short soft hold on capacity while they finalize PO terms? Details:

- Region: us-west-2 (pref) with fallback in us-east-1
- Expected steady-state: ~12 A100-equivalent GPUs for inference (p50 latency target 60ms), spiking to 20 for short experiments
- Model: 70B decoder, 2k context; plan to use int8 quantization + 4x batching to reduce footprint (SE note: S.E. will confirm effective vGPU)
- Start window: ~2029-01-10 (pilot start)
- Duration: pilot 8 weeks, then convert to reserved monthly commit if PO comes in

Can you run an availability check and (if feasible) place a soft hold that expires automatically if we don't receive a PO by 2028-12-20? If a manual approval is required for holds >10 GPUs, please flag. Also include estimated cost delta for holding vs committing so I can include in the executive summary.

Attachments: AxisAI inference requirements (axisai_inference_requirements_v2.pdf) — SE to update run-rate spreadsheet once I get your numbers.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, platform-ops@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 10:02:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Fleet reservation checkpoint: AxisAI late-stage capacity soft hold

Lauren —

Quick inventory check summary:

- us-west-2: currently available unreserved pool equivalent of ~48 A100s across Dedicated clusters (with mixed availability across zones).
- us-east-1: ~30 A100s available as fallback.
- We can place a soft hold for up to 16 GPUs in us-west-2 that will not impact automated autoscaling for higher-priority reserved contracts; the hold will be tagged as "soft-reserve/AX-4457".

Notes/constraints:
- Soft holds are advisory and enforced at provisioning time; they do not block capacity if we hit an unexpected SLA for higher-tier customers. If AxisAI requires true capacity reservation (guaranteed), we need a commit/PO and an internal approval for >10 GPU committed reservations.
- If Karhtik's engineering estimates that the model's effective vGPU is reduced via batching and quantization to require fewer physical GPUs, we should update the hold down accordingly — that reduces our opportunity cost.
- I estimated a 7-day operation to allocate nodes for the soft hold (tagging + leaderboard change + billing prep).

Prelim cost delta (soft hold vs committed reserve):
- Soft hold (16 GPUs, 8-week pilot hold window): documentation / operational reserve fee = ~$9,600/week (opportunity buffer + tagging overhead).
- Committed monthly reserve (post-PO): around $48,000/month for 16 A100-equivalents (approx; finance to confirm).

Action I can take now: place soft hold for 16 GPUs in us-west-2, expire 2028-12-20 23:59 PT unless we get an explicit PO / extension. Please confirm if 16 is the desired conservative number or if we should reduce to 12 pending SE quantization confirmation.

--
Ben Carter
Capacity Planning Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fleet reservation checkpoint: AxisAI late-stage capacity soft hold

Thanks Lauren / Ben —

Quick technical validation from SE side: we ran a matrix on AxisAI's model profile (70B decoder, 2k ctx) with our inference configs. Two important items:

1) Effective packing: with int8 + llama-compat kernels and batch size 4, we estimate an effective footprint equivalent to ~0.65 * single-GPU baseline (so their 12 logical GPU ask maps closer to 8 physical A100-equivalents). If they push batch to 8 for internal experiments, the factor improves further.

2) Latency target: with the given pairings and 2k context, 60ms p50 looks achievable at that packing rate under steady-state; p95 will require slight headroom. Recommend we set a canary of 4 GPUs for first week to validate polyfill with their payload (hooks + KV cache pattern).

Attached a short run-rate spreadsheet with the packing factors and expected vGPU -> physical GPU mapping (AX-4457-run-rate-estimates.xlsx).

Recommendation: reduce hold to 10 physical A100 equivalents for now (conservative), set a separate canary group of 4 GPUs reserved for a 7-day test, and expire soft hold 2028-12-20 unless PO received. If Ben can place a soft hold for 10 + canary 4 (total tagging 14 but billed/claimed differently), that would be ideal.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karhtik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, Sarah Li <sarah@axisai.com>, AxisAI Procurement <procurement@axisai.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Dec 2028 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fleet reservation checkpoint: AxisAI late-stage capacity soft hold

Everyone —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Karthik's packing analysis and Ben's availability check, let's proceed with the following:

1) Place a soft hold tagged "soft-reserve/AX-4457" for: 10 physical A100-equivalents (primary) + 4 physical A100s as a canary/test pool in us-west-2. Total tagged = 14.
2) Soft hold expiration: 2028-12-20 23:59 PT unless we receive a PO or an explicit extension from AxisAI.
3) Karthik: run the canary validation with AxisAI the week of 2029-01-10 and share telemetry in #deal-ax-4457 on Slack.
4) Ben: please add estimated weekly holding cost to the HubSpot deal (link below) and flag if a manual approval is required to extend past 12/20.

Sarah / AxisAI Procurement — thank you for moving quickly. If you can share the draft PO or an intent email by 12/20 we will convert the soft hold to a committed reservation and lock pricing. If you need additional time, let us know and we will route an approval request (note: extended holds may require a small fee).

Links: HubSpot deal https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/AX-4457 — I've attached our requirements + run-rate sheet for reference.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
